bayts.text: I have complained of my affairs and my immense sin to my Lord, the All-Powerful, the Forgiving, the Merciful.
So be for me the One Who removes complaint, and grant me the wishes, by the standing of the Prophet, the intercessor, the noble.
And bless him without end, and grant peace upon him with a lasting peace.
And be for me a protector here and tomorrow, and be for me a helper, for I am destitute.
And be gentle with me, and grant me good pleasure, and be for me Forgiving, for I am blameworthy.
And be for me a helper in my request, and be for me the One Who empowers, for I am weary.
And grant me righteousness, and grant me God-fearing, and illumine my heart and increase me in sciences.
And grant me salvation and increase me in guidance, and set my affairs right and increase me in bliss.
And remove my faults and increase me in loftiness, and heal my sickness and dispel the griefs.
And do not disgrace me, protect me from what destroys, and do not expose me for my being base.
For I am base, a captive of desire, and rebellious; but my God is Forbearing.
And grant well-being here and tomorrow to us and to whoever, through guidance, stays upright.
And bless the Chosen with a blessing, and grant peace upon him with a lasting peace.
